items: ¼ cup fresh basil, packed tight
1–2 fresh jalapeños, ribs and seeds removed, add slowly to desired heat

steps.title: Cut the chicken
steps.body: Cut **3 pounds boneless skinless thighs** in half, or thirds, and string on skewers.

steps.title: Mix the marinade
steps.body: Mix marinade: **3 cloves garlic**, minced, **1 tsp cumin**, **1 tsp chili powder**, **½ tsp red pepper flakes**, **1 tsp paprika**, **2 Tbsp brown sugar**, **2 Tbsp olive oil**, **2 Tbsp soy sauce**, **2 Tbsp fresh lime juice** and **2 Tbsp grated ginger**.

steps.title: Marinate
steps.body: Marinate chicken, refrigerated, for 30 minutes–4 hours.

steps.title: Grill
steps.body: Skewer and grill in oiled grill.

steps.title: Blend the green sauce
steps.body: Serve with green sauce made with the following ingredients blended: **1¼ cups fresh cilantro**, packed tight, **¼ cup fresh basil**, packed tight, **2 Tbsp fresh cotijo cheese**, **1 Tbsp chopped ginger**, **1 tsp honey**, **1 clove garlic**, **1 Tbsp olive oil**, **2 Tbsp fresh lime juice**, **½ cup mayonnaise**, **1 Tbsp Amarillo paste**, if available, **1–2 fresh jalapeños**, ribs and seeds removed, add slowly to desired heat, and salt to taste.
